scope: Independent Spanish release review of the 530 new retained entries and three amended baseline entries. Checked all fresh definitions, examples, part of speech, gender, supplied alternative forms, register, and supplied English lexical-reference meanings. Reused 268 authenticated prior no-issue Spanish verdicts for unchanged learner content; no new independent placement certification, audio or human review is claimed.
reuseMethod: Prior candidate full canonical entry hash must match the prior Spanish verdict. Compare current and prior term, normalizedTerm, partOfSpeech, definition, example, translation, gender, alternativeForms and register. Historical preview drops exampleSurfaceForm and lexicalEvidence metadata; omission is not an authored learner-content change. The three amended baseline terms are freshly reviewed regardless of possible reuse.

references.purpose: Confirm common gender for wine-service occupation
Check door-side/frame meaning and jamba synonym; no blocking finding
Confirm feminine adjectival use for childbirth sense
